text:
nick: opened a tiny PR to add a short howto for cost attribution in dashboard widgets + a node snippet for trace->cost mapping. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/899

tara: can you paste the node snippet? i'll run it in the examples harness.

nick: here it is:
```js
// attach cost tag so dashboards can group by billing buckets
await client.traces.create({
  name: 'checkout',
  tags: { cost_bucket: 'cart-high' },
  metrics: { estimated_cost_cents: 120 }
});
```

lucy: quick note: examples use `tags` everywhere, but the yaml widget config in the PR uses `meta.cost_bucket`. we should be consistent.

nick: good catch. i'll update the widget to read `trace.tags.cost_bucket` instead of `trace.meta.cost_bucket`.

docs-bot: lint: found absolute link to internal-runbook.md. replace with relative path `../runbooks/internal-runbook.md`.

tara: also please add a one-line normalize helper to the snippet to avoid missing trailing slashes for prefix keys. small test too.

nick: will add helper and test. pushing fixes now.

site-bot: preview build queued (job #10123).

lucy: thanks, once CI green i'll do a quick review and merge.

nick: thanks team :thumbsup:
